findings.title: Status log carries the superseded R-crc-4 wording the ruling itself records as corrected
findings.recommendation: Line 807 reads 'R-crc-4 AMENDED — the pair is SPAWNED SIMULTANEOUSLY rather than packaged and awaited'. R-crc-4 (lines 115-122) records that this exact wording overreached and was CORRECTED the same day: external means a cross-vendor handoff a human runs in another tool, and orbit inside one assistant cannot spawn an agent of a different vendor. The log is append-only by design, so the fix is an appended pointer to the correction, never a rewrite of the entry.

findings.title: Exit criterion 3 leaves the budget-spent record shape ambiguous
findings.recommendation: rc02's exit criterion 3 reads 'the next archive on this repo proceeds through the stop rule, or with the gate reporting its budget spent — never a gate_overridden for "no clean pass yet"'. The 2026-09-14 archive satisfies it — the override's reason IS the budget-spent clause — but the record shows a gate_overridden either way, so telling the sanctioned case from the prohibited one requires reading the reason string. rc04 (cost visibility, which already owns what the user decides at archive) is the place to make budget-spent proceeds distinguishable at a glance.

findings.title: Shipped audit-drift payload schema is rejected by the engine on first use

The reference already dates the three-way divergence and assigns it to rc07 (artifact-lint), with the parity test recording it as a named exception — but nothing records that the documented shape does not merely diverge in TYPE, it fails outright, so the command's own Step 10 is unfollowable from its shipped reference.
